column4: naraṃ virecayati yaṃ sa yogāt sukhamaśnute //
yuñjyād ya enamatyantamāyuṣā ca sukhena ca //
balaṃ puṣṭirapatyaṃ ca vṛṣatā cāsya jāyate //
jitāḥ saṃśodhanairye tu na teṣāṃ punarudbhavaḥ //
doṣāṇāṃ ca drumāṇāṃ ca mūle 'anupahate sati /
tathā sa labhate śarma yujyate cāyuṣā ciram //
snehane svedane śuddhau rogāḥ saṃsarjane ca ye /
kā vā cikitsā bhagavan kimarthaṃ vā prayujyate //
sā cikitsā vikārāṇāṃ karma tadbhiṣajāṃ smṛtam //
kathaṃ śarīre dhātūnāṃ vaiṣamyaṃ na bhavediti /
yā ca yuktiścikitsāyāṃ yaṃ cārthaṃ kurute bhiṣak /
ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte ślokasthāne cikitsāprābhṛtīyo nāma ṣoḍaśo dhyāyaḥ //
